Voice Portal AI — Create & Share Songs in Your Own Voice

Voice Portal AI brings the magic of voice and music creation to your fingertips. Record your voice, train a custom voice model, and generate complete AI songs — all performed in your own voice. Then share them with a community of creators and discover what others are making.

Create AI-generated songs with original lyrics, melodies, and genres. Perform them using your own custom voice model. Showcase your best work on your public library, follow other creators, and explore a feed full of fresh AI music every day.

Discover Feed – Scroll a personalized feed of AI songs from creators around the world. Like, share, and find your next favorite voice.

Creator Profiles & Public Library – Showcase your songs and voice models on your profile. Follow creators you love and build an audience for your own work.

AI Song Generation – Create full songs with AI-generated lyrics, melodies, and genres.

Custom Voice Models – Train a voice model from your own recordings, using just a short sample.

Voice-to-Song Cloning – Perform AI-generated songs in your own voice.

Pitch Control – Shift your performance between vocal ranges without retraining your model.

Text-to-Speech – Type any text and hear it spoken in your own voice. Supports 30+ languages with automatic language detection.

Playlists – Build your own collection of favorite AI-generated tracks.

Secure Multi-Device Sync – Access your voices and songs across devices.

Favorites – Quickly access your most-used voices and songs.

Open AskPlay and just ask. Type or say what you want — "play something like Radiohead," "queue some 90s hip-hop," "save this as a playlist" — and AskPlay's AI makes it happen. No menus. No digging. No breaking your flow.

-

Please note, to access the app and all of its features, it is required: an Apple Music subscription, access to Apple Intelligence Private Cloud Compute or an AI provider API key, and to purchase a subscription to AskPlay.

-

WHAT YOU CAN SAY
▸ Play anything
"Play Abbey Road by The Beatles" · "Put on some Daft Punk"
▸ Build a mix on the spot · Real, hand-picked songs for any mood, era, or theme.
"Play the best of the 2000s" · "Play upbeat summer songs"
▸ Discover more like it
"More like this" · "Bands like blink-182" · "Songs like my gym playlist"
▸ Start a station
"Play smooth rock radio" · "Play my personal station"
▸ Run the queue
"Queue some Led Zeppelin" · "Play Redbone next"
▸ Control playback
"Skip this" · "Shuffle on" · "Repeat this song" · "Skip to 1:30"
▸ Grow your library
"Add this to my library" · "Add this to my Chill Vibes playlist" · "Heart this"
▸ Just ask
"What's playing?" · "Who sings this?" · "What's next?"

BUILT TO UNDERSTAND YOU
AskPlay knows the difference between play, queue, play-next, and make-a-mix — even from subtle wording. It handles nuance ("don't play anything like Nickelback" won't backfire), offers clear choices when you're vague instead of erroring out, and makes a confident best guess rather than pestering you with questions.

TYPE OR TALK
Tap the mic and start talking, or just type. AskPlay can pause your music while you speak, then pick right back up.

PLAYLIST MAKER
The separate Playlist Maker allows you to build the perfect playlist, with help from AI.

SIRI & SHORTCUTS
Integrates with Siri and Shortcuts so that you can ask for music, even when outside the app.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
Designed for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. Now Playing, artwork, and your full queue are always a glance away — tap any track to jump to it, swipe to remove, or drag to reorder. On iPad and Apple Vision Pro, a spacious Listening Desk sets your cover art beside the queue.

YOUR AI, YOUR CHOICE
AskPlay is bring-your-own-provider. Connect OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), or OpenRouter, pick your exact model, and control your own usage. Your key stays in your device's Keychain — never on our servers.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your prompts and listening history aren't logged. No account beyond your App Store subscription, AI key, and Apple Music. Your taste stays yours.

-

Turn a prompt or your own lyrics into a complete song—or, with the Opus subscription, a hum or a recording. Your first song from a prompt or your own lyrics is free, with no sign-up or card required.

FROM IDEA TO FULL SONG
Describe a sound, mood, or story. Choose a genre, add your own lyrics, let Opus write them, or make an instrumental, then hear it back in about a minute. Every song comes in two versions.

START WITH YOUR VOICE (OPUS SUBSCRIPTION)
Sing, hum, or rap into your phone—or import audio you own or have the rights to use—and make it the starting point for a new arrangement.

SHAPE THE RESULT
Extend a song, reuse the style of any song (or the style and lyrics of your own), and make another version without starting over. With the Opus subscription, you can also restyle a song with Cover or Remix, blend two of your songs into one, and save the voice and style of a song you made as a Persona for future songs.

FIND THE MOMENT WORTH SHARING
Hook Finder suggests the part of your track most worth sharing and marks it on the waveform. Adjust the clip, choose 15, 30, or 60 seconds, and share the moment that lands.

LISTEN, SAVE, AND DISCOVER
Play your songs with full lyrics and lock-screen controls, keep favorites in your library, and publish only the tracks you choose. Like songs and follow creators on Discover, and set up a public profile with a photo, cover photo, and bio.

CREDITS AND SUBSCRIPTION
Making a song uses credits. The Opus subscription is billed weekly or yearly. It includes credits that refresh every week on the weekly plan and every month on the yearly plan (unused plan credits don't carry over), and it unlocks the Gen 4 and Gen 5 models, songs from your recordings and imported audio, Cover, Remix, Persona, song blends, and WAV export. Prefer not to subscribe? Buy a one-time credit pack to make more songs with the free features—pack credits never expire. Prices and allowances are shown before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.

You are responsible for the prompts, recordings, and files you upload and for how you use generated output.
